0SHA 1910 or regional equivalent applies no matter the industry (sans Construction - 1926)

- Identify IDLH -> address immediately
- Address previously identified audit findings
- Risk assessment all activities, risk rank, road map CAPA's accordingly
- Institute Strategic Initiatives
    - Institute Tactical Initiatives to accomplish the Strategies



ISO 45001 - OH & S Mngmt System
ISO 14001 - Environmental Mngmt System
ISO 50001 - Energy Mngmt System
ISO 9001 - Quality Mngmt System

**Strategic Initiatives**

- Building Relationships of Trust from the OKTA C-Suite to the office worker to the vendors and across different disciplines of the organization (Physical Security, IT resources, Engineering, Architecture, Construction, etc.)
    - Through scheduled touchpoints
    - Monthly Business Reviews
        - KPI/OKR reviews
        - Audit results, findings, corrective action tracking
- Fostering a GLOBAL program that is safety conscious culture
    - Through coaching front-line supervision to lead with safety in 1:1's, daily meetings
    - Empowering workers to own the program, "it's their program, I'm here to help provide guidance and best practices"



Leading indicators:

1. % Training completion
2. BBS Observations and turnaround time for resolution (if applicable)
3. Inspections and Audits performed and findings resolved in prescribed time
4. Safety Committee Participation
5. Layers of Risk Assessments baked into Construction, Vendor or Operations projects
6. Health and Safety participation in planning phase of development (Safety-in-Design) for Construction new builds and retro-fits
7. Vendor/Contractor Management touchpoints and engagements

Lagging indicators:

8. Incident Rate
9. Recordable Incident Rate
10. # of Lost Days
11. # of Days of Modified/Restricted Duty
12. Measuring Incident Investigation Corrective Action effectiveness
